text: This major mainly studies the development and utilization of traditional energy sources (such as coal, oil, natural gas, etc.) and emerging energy sources (such as wind energy, solar energy, nuclear energy, etc.), and is committed to solving problems such as efficient energy utilization and environmental protection. At the same time, it also involves the design, manufacture, testing and optimization technologies of thermal equipment such as internal combustion engines, boilers, aero engines and refrigerators, aiming to cultivate professional talents who can promote the development of the energy industry and achieve sustainable energy utilization.
